reviews.text: Moras has been a wonderful contractor for commercial coatings for our business. I would recommend him to anyone looking to get an Acrylabs roof coating.
reviews.author: Joshua W.

reviews.text: High Quality Customer Care, Communication, & Delivery of Service! I am selling my home & needed roof repairs on a time crunch. Moras Construction Delivered Punctual Service, Picture Evidence of proposed rubber roof repairs & final product of their service!
reviews.author: Heather A.

reviews.text: Excellent service! Moras Construction repaired a roof leak for us and they were so responsive. Communication was excellent and they even send a report with pictures of the repairs! Top notch service. We will definitely be using them again.
reviews.author: April C.
